title: DIAMOND LOVE: THE MUSIC OF SADE
tickerText:
The music of singer/songwriter Melody Crystal. 
Currently performing a self produced show with an 8 piece band at venues around Australia.  Diamond Love: The Music Of Sade.      Sade is the iconic British band fronted by singer Sade Adu, known for an unmistakable blend of soul, jazz, R&B and sophisticated pop. Emerging in the 1980s with songs such as Smooth Operator and Your Love Is King, their music combines elegant arrangements with Sade’s warm, understated vocals. Across albums including Diamond Life, Promise and Love Deluxe, Sade created a timeless sound filled with romance, longing, heartbreak and quiet intensity that continues to find new audiences.
